summary: Testing complete for Dynamic Emission Configuration feature. All 5 features verified successfully: (1) SuperAdmin can access Emission Configuration page at /super-admin/emission-configuration, (2) SuperAdmin can create scope-to-formula mappings, (3) Scope 2 → Electricity Emissions mapping exists and works, (4) Admin Scope 2 emission calculation uses the configured formula dynamically, (5) Unit conversion (1000 kWh → 1 MWh) and calculation result (0.71 tCO2, not 710 tCO2) are correct on first attempt.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dynamic Emission Configuration feature is fully functional. SuperAdmin can configure scope-to-formula mappings at /super-admin/emission-configuration. Admin emission calculations dynamically use the configured formulas. The key architecture: emissionConfigurations collection maps scopes to formulas, findFormulaForScope() looks up the mapping, and calculatedEmissions useMemo uses the formula's input_mappings for dynamic parameter resolution. Unit conversion (kWh → MWh) works correctly via formula_parameters collection with multiplier 1000 (divide by 1000 to convert).
